574-7084-8347.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-7084-8347.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

643-3000-3510-3875.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3000-3510-3875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

803-4779-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-4779-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

728-5961--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3899-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
3899-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

2730-3899-6553.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4050-6772.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding one mana of any color
When the creature dies, Syr Vondam and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1170-2099-4985-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-4985-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Jhoira's Familiar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

2021-2060-3062-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

813-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
813-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-1753-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-1753-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2033-7297-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-7297-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-7297-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2092-2757-4771-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Myr Scrapling, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

147-2921-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

985-2464-3459-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
985-2464-3459-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

3398-5334-7121.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3398-5334-7121.description:
Activate Fire Nation Palace's second ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, giving Hellkite Charger firebending 4 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it and its firebending ability twice.
Resolve both Hellkite Charger firebending triggers, adding eight {R}.
Resolve the first Hellkite Charger trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-5089-6705.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

967-997-2557-3809-7087.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2558-5315-7082.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Sokka and Suki trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Ally.
Repeat from step 2.

681-5413-5478-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-5413-5478-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2523-3705-6896.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
When Squee dies, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Repeat.

3769-5231-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-5231-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

585-3767-3918-5116.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5727-6705-6797.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Frog creature token.
When the Frog enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

191-4067-6625.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
191-4067-6625.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Curator of Mysteries triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

586-3967-4924-5258-5618.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4693-5478-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4693-5478-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Repeat.

856-2034-4321-5631.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2034-4321-5631.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Skeleton Crew trigger.
Resolve the Skeleton Crew trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

1329-1778-2178-4779.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-4779.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1789-2034-4452-5649.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-2034-4452-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1799-5231-5359-5496.description:
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

643-3951-5256-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-5256-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1974-2713-3719-5326.notablePrerequisites: Quicksilver Gargantuan has a power of at least 2.
1974-2713-3719-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Quicksilver Gargantuan and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Quicksilver Gargantuan from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Quicksilver Gargantuan to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

2713-4613-4929-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's second ability by paying {1}, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2713-4613-4929-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

803-3967-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-3967-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-3967-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Snail.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-2292-5263.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 3, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Repeat.

1734-1998-4605.description:
Cast Charming Prince by paying {1}{W}.
When Charming Prince enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Fiend Hunter until the next end step.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield under their owner's control.
At the beginning of your end step, Charming Prince triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Fiend Hunter trigger, exiling Charming Prince.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a copy of Fiend Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling the nontoken Fiend Hunter until the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
When the nontoken Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Charming Prince from exile to the battlefield.
When Charming Prince enters the battlefield, it and Preston trigger, with Charming Prince targeting the Fiend Hunter token.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Charming Prince that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the token Charming Prince enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling the Fiend Hunter token.
When the token Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning the nontoken Fiend Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 5.

282-986-3073-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Delina and Lightning Runner.
282-986-3073-4918.description:
Declare Delina and Lightning Runner as attackers, triggering them each twice.
Resolve a Delina trigger, creating at least one token copy of Electrostatic Pummeler that enters the battlefield tapped and attacking.
When the Electrostatic Pummeler token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get at least {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 2 for the remaining Delina trigger.
Resolve the Lightning Runner triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E} and pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, each creature token created by Delina triggers, exiling themselves.
Repeat each combat phase.
Once you have infinite {E}, you may target any other creature(s) you control.

1812-2367-2440-2471-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Servos.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
1812-2367-2440-2471-3490.description:
Activate Zabaz's first ability by paying {R}, destroying another artifact creature you control.
When the creature dies, Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Servos to start the combo, this combo nets infinite mana.

360-2161-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
360-2161-3490-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1335-2034-2265.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2034-2265.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1445-2267-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4050.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.
